#!/usr/bin/env python3
from statsmodels.tsa.filters import hp_filter
import numpy as np

# Data from Treasury Bulletin: FY 2010-2024
# Total receipts and total outlays in millions of dollars
fiscal_years = list(range(2010, 2025))

# Actual receipts and outlays (in millions)
receipts = [
    2161728,  # 2010
    2302495,  # 2011
    2449092,  # 2012
    2773979,  # 2013
    3020847,  # 2014
    3248722,  # 2015
    3266689,  # 2016
    3314893,  # 2017
    3328745,  # 2018
    3462195,  # 2019
    3419955,  # 2020
    4045980,  # 2021
    4896119,  # 2022
    4439283,  # 2023
    4918737,  # 2024
]

outlays = [
    3455931,  # 2010
    3598086,  # 2011
    3538447,  # 2012
    3454254,  # 2013
    3504199,  # 2014
    3687623,  # 2015
    3854101,  # 2016
    3980720,  # 2017
    4107741,  # 2018
    4446583,  # 2019
    6551871,  # 2020
    6818159,  # 2021
    6271508,  # 2022
    6134433,  # 2023
    6751553,  # 2024
]

# Apply Hodrick-Prescott filter with lambda=100
# For annual data, lambda=100 is the standard smoothing parameter
lambda_param = 100

# Compute HP trend for receipts
receipts_cycle, receipts_trend = hp_filter.hpfilter(receipts, lamb=lambda_param)

# Compute HP trend for outlays
outlays_cycle, outlays_trend = hp_filter.hpfilter(outlays, lamb=lambda_param)

# Calculate actual balance and structural balance for each year
actual_balance = [r - o for r, o in zip(receipts, outlays)]
structural_balance = [round(r_trend - o_trend) for r_trend, o_trend in zip(receipts_trend, outlays_trend)]

# Round actual balance to nearest whole number
actual_balance_rounded = [round(x) for x in actual_balance]

# Print results
print("FY\tReceipts\tOutlays\t\tActual Balance\tStructural Balance\tGap")
print("-" * 90)
for i, year in enumerate(fiscal_years):
    gap = abs(actual_balance_rounded[i] - structural_balance[i])
    print(f"{year}\t{receipts[i]:,}\t{outlays[i]:,}\t{actual_balance_rounded[i]:,}\t{structural_balance[i]:,}\t{gap:,}")

print("\n" + "=" * 90)
print("FY 2024 Results:")
print(f"  1) Actual balance:    {actual_balance_rounded[14]:,}")
print(f"  2) Structural balance: {structural_balance[14]:,}")
print(f"  3) Gap (absolute):    {abs(actual_balance_rounded[14] - structural_balance[14]):,}")

# Format for answer
actual_2024 = actual_balance_rounded[14]
structural_2024 = structural_balance[14]
gap_2024 = abs(actual_2024 - structural_2024)

# Output formatted as requested
print(f"\nAnswer: [{actual_2024}, {structural_2024}, {gap_2024}]")

from statsmodels.tsa.filters import hp_filter

# HP filter with lambda=100
_, receipts_trend = hp_filter.hpfilter(receipts, lamb=100)
_, outlays_trend = hp_filter.hpfilter(outlays, lamb=100)

# Print FY 2024 details

"
